summary: Implemented the window-title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests, mypy, and Black were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed.
